page.notes: Printed page number at top left is an old-style "20"; read as 20 with doubt. Faint reference marks in the left margin near the first lines (a small triangle and dots beside "quevi") are not legible as text and were not transcribed. The word "crediturosiam" in the text is uncertain; the "i" may be a j. "Etiamsi" and "de" in the italic quotation are read from an italic scan and may differ slightly. The bottom-right catchword is set with a ligature "st" and is read as "tendam" with doubt; it continues the hyphenated "ample-". The line "esse desinant" is read from a long-s ligature and may be "effe". No show-through or stamps were transcribed.
